visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The visual sequence initiates with a high-definition close-up of a silver smartphone, which is suspended vertically from a metal ring. The device's rear surface has a matte metallic finish, reflecting soft light. It then transitions to a medium shot of an Asian male creator with short black hair, wearing a white long-sleeve tee. He is positioned in an indoor room with a warm lamp and a bed, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. Large yellow and white text overlays are present at the top of the frame. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the silver phone's camera module, revealing two vertically aligned lenses. The phone is placed on a dark surface in a studio setting. The scene shifts back to the man in the white shirt who continues to talk enthusiastically, his eyes wide and hands moving dynamically to emphasize his points. The indoor bedroom setting remains constant with soft, warm lighting. More white captions appear at the bottom of the screen to transcribe his words. (3) A technical view shows the smartphone spinning slowly on a mechanical hanger, showcasing its extremely thin side profile against a dark studio background. The side buttons and metallic frame are highlighted by bright studio lights. The video then returns to the man in the room, who holds up his hands to describe the device's physical dimensions. He wears a black watch and a small black microphone is clipped to his white collar. (4) In a side-by-side comparison shot, a hand is seen placing several smartphones on a white tabletop, including a navy blue S25 and a larger silver S25 Ultra for scale. The man is then shown again in the bedroom setting, using his thumb and index finger to mimic a tiny gap, illustrating the 1mm thickness difference. Yellow variety-show style text flashes briefly on screen to emphasize the specific measurement being discussed. (5) The camera provides a clear view of the phone's front screen, which is illuminated and displays a light-colored wallpaper. The bezels are notably thin. The final sequence features the man talking in his indoor room, smiling and looking directly at the lens. He uses varied hand gestures, occasionally touching his chin or pointing towards the viewer. The background remains consistent with the warm lamp and domestic interior elements throughout the shot.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 三星無預警發布 超薄手機 S25 edge. [Subtitle]: 各位我剛參加完 三星 Galaxy 的發佈會. (2) [Subtitle]: 就在發佈會結束的時候 竟然無預警的發布了 第四支手機 也就是 S25 Edge. (3) [Subtitle]: 也就是傳聞當中的 S25 Slim 那 Edge 這個名字呢. (4) [Subtitle]: 其實已經睽違了 七.八年沒有出新機了 沒想到在 2025 年回歸. (5) [Subtitle]: 可惜不能實際摸 所以整體多輕 我並不清楚. (6) [Subtitle]: 但是從畫面中大家可以看到 真的非常薄 基本上是只比開機鍵 跟音量鍵再厚一點點而已. (7) [Subtitle]: 推估有可能是 6.多 mm 要知道現在的 S25 大概是 7mm. (8) [Subtitle]: S25 Ultra 大概是 8mm 也就是說它會比原本最薄的 S25 再薄快 1mm. (9) [Subtitle]: 從背面上來看其實有一點像 iPhone 16 它就是直式鏡頭排列 推測應該沒有給超廣角. (10) [Subtitle]: 那正面螢幕其實有點亮 所以應該是可以開機的 只是不給我們操作. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以實際重量比 S25 輕多少 嚴格講不敢說. (12) [Subtitle]: 但可以想像是它的手感 一定是 S25 系列裡面 最好的一支手機. (13) [Subtitle]: 個人猜測應該會比 iPhone 17 系列還要更早 它應該就是要搶頭香 應該會跟 Fold 還有 Flip 一起上吧. (14) [Variety]: (你們覺得呢). [Subtitle]: 可能就六七月左右.
